title: Is balanced
statementMd:
A tree is height-balanced if for every node the heights of its two subtrees differ by at most one. Return whether it is. The tree is given as a level-order list where `None` marks a missing child (like `[3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7]`); the helper `build_tree` in the solution shows how it is read, and in your function the argument is already that list.

**Example:** `is_balanced([3, 9, 20, null, null, 15, 7])` returns `true`.
hints: Compute heights bottom-up and return a sentinel for imbalance.
